spans.s: जतु n. The red resin of certain trees.

जातु ind. A particle meaning- (1) ever, at any time, at all, न जातु कामः कामानामुपभिगेन शाम्यति M.ii.94; (2) at some time, some day, once upon a time, once.जातु is used with a potential form in the sense of ‘not putting up with,’ e.g. जातु वृषलं याजयेन्न मर्षयामि; and with a present indicative to imply censure, e.g. जातु वृषलं याजयति.
जतु-अश्मक n. red arsenic.
जतु-पुत्रक m. a man at chess &c.
जतु-रस m. lac.
जतुक n. Lac.
जतुका f. 1. Lac; 2. a bat.
जतुनी f. A bat.
जतुनी f. A bat.
जत्रु n. The collar bone, the clavicle, e.g. गूढजत्रुररिंदमः.
जात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Brought into existence, engendered; 2. grown, produced; 3. caused, occasioned; 4. happened, (pp. of जन् q.v.).
जात (II) m. Male offspring, a son; (in plays, it is used as a term of affection).

जात (III) n. 1. A creature, a living being; 2. production, origin; 3. kind, class, species; 4. a collection of things forming a class, e.g. येन वा भवति सुखजातम् Git.G.x. (i.e. everything included under सुख ‘complete happiness’), or निःशेषविश्राणितकोशजातम् (i.e. all kinds of wealth); 5. a child, a young one.
जात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Brought into existence, engendered; 2. grown, produced; 3. caused, occasioned; 4. happened, (pp. of जन् q.v.).
जात-इष्टि f. sacrifice performed at the birth of a child.
जात-उक्ष m. a young bullock.
जात-कर्मन् n. a ceremony performed at the birth of a child, R.iii.18.
जात-कलाप a. having a tail (as a peacock).
जात-पाश a. fettered.
जात-प्रत्यय a. inspired with confidence.
जात-मन्मथ a. fallen in love.
जात-मात्र a. just born.
जात-रूप (I) a. beautiful, brilliant.
जात-रूप (II) n. gold, न जातरूपच्छदजातरूपता द्विजस्य दृष्टेऽयमिति स्तुवन् मुहुः Na.i.129.
जात-वेदस् m. an epithet of Agni, Sis.ii.51, R, xii.104, xv.72.
जातक (I) a. (f. का) Born, produced.
जातक (II) m. 1. A mendicant; 2. a new born infant.
जातक (III) n. 1. A ceremony performed after the birth of a child (जातकर्मन्); 2. astrological calculation of a nativity; 3. a collection of similar things.
जातक (I) a. (f. का) Born, produced.

जाति f. 1. Birth, production, Bhartr.i.90; 2. family, race, lineage; 3. caste, high caste, जातिर्यातु रसातलं गुणगणस्तस्याप्यधस्तिष्ठतु Bhartr.ii.39; (there are four primary castes of the Hindus- ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य and शूद्र); 4. class, genus, species; 5. properties which are peculiar to a class and distinguish it from all others, K.Pr.ii., Sis.ii.47; 6. futile answer (in Nyāya Phil.); 7. a fireplace; 8. seven primary notes in Hindu music; 9. the jasmine plant or its flower, पुष्पाणां प्रकरः स्मितेन रचितो ना कुंदजात्यादिभिः Am.
; 10. mace, nutmeg; (written also जाती in the last two senses).
जाति-अंध a. born blind, Bhartr.i.90.
जाति-कोश, -कोष m.n. nutmeg.
जाति-कोश, -कोष m.n. nutmeg.
जाति-कोशी, -कोषी f. the outer skin of the nutmeg.
जाति-कोशी, -कोषी f. the outer skin of the nutmeg.
जाति-धर्म m. 1. the duties of a caste; 2. a generic property.
जाति-ध्वंस m. loss of caste or its privileges.
जाति-पत्री f. the outer skin of the nut-meg.
जाति-ब्राह्मण m. a Brāhmaṇa only by birth, an ignorant Brāhmaṇa (तपः श्रुतं च योनिश्च त्रयं ब्राह्मण्यकारणम् । तपःश्रुताभ्यां यो हीनो जातिब्राह्मण एव सः).
जाति-भ्रंश m. loss of caste, M.xi.67.
जाति-भ्रष्ट a. outcaste.
जाति-मत् a. of high rank.
जाति-मात्र n. 1. position in life obtained by mere birth; 2. caste only (but not the performance of duties attached to it), M.viii.20, xii.114.
जाति-लक्षण n. generic distinction, a characteristic.
जाति-वाचक a. expressing a genus, generic (as a word), e.g. गौः.
जाति-वैर n. instinctive hostility.
जाति-वैरिन् m. born enemy.
जाति-शब्द m. a name or word expressing a genus, a generic word, a common noun, e.g. गौः.
जाति-संकर m. mixed blood, mixture of caste.
जाति-संपन्न a. belonging to a noble family.
जाति-सार n. nutmeg.
जाति-स्मर a. remembering one’s condition in the former life.
जाति-स्वभाव m. generic character.
जाति-हीन a. of low birth, outcaste.
जातुधान m. A demon.
जातुष a. (f. षी) 1. Made of lac, covered with lac; 2. sticky, adhesive.
जातुष a. (f. षी) 1. Made of lac, covered with lac; 2. sticky, adhesive.
जात्य a. (f. त्या) 1. Of the same family, related; 2. noble, well-born, of noble birth, जात्यस्तेनाभिजातेन शूरः शौर्यवता कुशः R.xvii.4; 3. lovely, beautiful.
जात्य a. (f. त्या) 1. Of the same family, related; 2. noble, well-born, of noble birth, जात्यस्तेनाभिजातेन शूरः शौर्यवता कुशः R.xvii.4; 3. lovely, beautiful.
